basic_info.description:
This charming home in Miraloma Park is ready for its next chapter and your creative vision. Featuring two generously sized bedrooms and a full bathroom with both a shower stall and tub, the layout is functional and inviting. The living room boasts a large window with a panoramic city view.

The upper level includes a formal living room, dining room, and two bedrooms. A wood staircase leads to a one-car garage with ample space, both floors features supplemental room. Note: Buyer should investigate and satisfy themselves with sq ft/ # of bedroom and bathroom before submit any offers 

Conveniently located near shops, cafes, and freeway access, this home is close to Glen Park Village, BART, West Portal, and Noe Valley. Sheltered by Mt. Davidson, it enjoys a pleasant climate in a highly desirable neighborhood.

The backyard is perfect for gardening or creating outdoor living spaces. 

With classic charm and great potential, this property is a comfortable city haven, brimming with possibilities. Dont miss itready for your personal touch!
